title: Pareto-Optimal and Strategyproof Data-Sharing Between Competitors
abstract: arXiv:2611.26108v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study data-sharing among firms competing in the same market through the quality of their predictive models. We model firms' profit through two main components, precision and market share, where the former depends on the firm's own number of datapoints and the latter depends on the endowments of all firms. We characterize Pareto-optimal contracts as those in which at least one firm receives all of the other firms' datapoints. We then propose a parametric family of data-sharing contracts and show that, under any of them, the relative market shares of all firms remain constant, eliminating the negative effect of sharing data with competitors and equalizing all firms' gains relative to the no-sharing scenario. We further show that one contract within this family satisfies both Pareto-optimality and strategyproofness against firms attempting to under-declare the size of their initial endowment. translated_title: 竞争者之间帕累托最优且防策略操纵的数据共享
translated_abstract: 我们研究在同一市场中通过预测模型质量进行竞争的企业之间的数据共享问题。我们通过两个主要组成部分对企业利润进行建模：精度和市场份额，其中前者取决于企业自身的数据点数量，后者取决于所有企业的数据禀赋。我们将帕累托最优合同刻画为至少有一家企业获得所有其他企业数据点的合同。随后，我们提出了一族参数化的数据共享合同，并证明在其中任何一种合同下，所有企业的相对市场份额保持不变，从而消除了与竞争对手共享数据的负面影响，并使所有企业相对于不共享情形的收益均等化。我们进一步证明，该合同族中的某一个合同同时满足帕累托最优性和防策略操纵性，即能够防止企业少报其初始数据禀赋规模。最后，我们利用真实世界数据集进行了实证验证。
tldr: 本文提出了一族数据共享合同，使竞争企业的相对市场份额保持不变，并证明其中一种合同同时满足帕累托最优性和防止企业少报数据量的防策略操纵性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a family of data-sharing contracts that keeps firms' relative market shares constant, and identifies one contract that is both Pareto-optimal and strategyproof against firms under-declaring their initial data endowments.
